topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture framework on cancer evolution and outlines the core learning objectives regarding Darwinian selection and microenvironmental factors.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how Darwinian natural selection operates through successive genetic mutations and epigenetic transcriptional alterations to confer competitive growth advantages on cell clones.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue hierarchies and the developmental state of the initiating cell dictate susceptibility to malignant transformation and tumor propagation.

topics.label: Environmental Promotion and Inflammatory Signaling in Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that cancer-predisposing mutations require permissive promotional signals from environmental stimuli and chronic inflammation to drive tumor outgrowth.

topics.label: Stromal Dependency in Established Tumors and Therapeutic Targeting
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains why established tumors require supportive stromal microenvironments for survival and explores how targeting these non-cancerous supporting cells provides therapeutic opportunities.

topics.label: Experimental and Computational Technologies for Tumor Profiling
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the modern genomic, computational, and spatial profiling tools used to investigate cancer evolutionary dynamics and cellular interactions within tissues.

topics.label: Integrative Framework of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic mutations, cellular origin, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental pressures converge to enable cancer evolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the next session on cancer therapy.
